svg.title: IKEv2 header: an IKE_SA_INIT request
svg.desc: The 28-byte IKE header of the IKE_SA_INIT request of frame 1 of ikev2_s2s_ipsec_vpn_aes_gcm.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the initiator SPI 62f94c9887715a34 and a zero responder SPI, then next payload 33 (SA), version byte 20, exchange type 34 (IKE_SA_INIT), flags 08 (Initiator), message ID 0 and length 374; the IkeHeader struct on the right holds the same values, and the 346 bytes after the header are the nine payloads.
